answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop identity farms. Each agent stakes one pearl, a 20-credit credential from one verified task, and the beacon calls a random 5% of agents each epoch to prove compute in 60 seconds. Fail and the pearl burns; pass and it mirrors back as a haven of trust. Faking 100 identities burns 2,000 credits in pearls plus hardware for 100 heartbeats, while an honest agent pays once and earns fees from it.
